parallel.requirements: Recognized the cleanroom requirement, CLI observation-only constraint, static outputs, parse behavior, and the missing std.cfg baseline behavior of the original binary.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent did initial exploration, moved the original binary to executable.orig, then delegated six probe-only behavioral areas through AgentSwarm and kept consolidation/implementation for later parent work.
parallel.implementation: No replacement implementation was written in the parallel run; the work product was probe files and reports under /workspace/probes plus preserved docs and executable.orig.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The final artifact had no required ./executable and no integrated source implementation, so there was no runnable submitted replacement to evaluate.
parallel.verification: Verification was exploratory only: the parent and children ran many behavioral probes, but there was no implementation and no final whole-task verification loop.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run was cancelled after post-swarm probing, before writing source, packaging a replacement executable, or validating any final behavior.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same cleanroom task but also discovered that placing a minimal cfg/std.cfg beside the executable allowed richer original-binary behavior to be observed.
serial.plan_and_ownership: One actor owned probing, behavior consolidation, implementation, captured static data, source writing, and final executable creation without delegation.
serial.implementation: The serial run copied captured help/errorlist data and wrote a Python implementation at src/cppcheck.py, then appended tokenizer/preprocessor code and syntax-checked it.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The final artifact included data/help.txt, data/errorlist.xml, cfg/std.cfg, src/cppcheck.py, and a final ./executable, although artifact validation still failed.
serial.verification: Serial performed local probes against the original, did at least a syntax parse of the implementation, but did not complete evaluator-passing validation before cancellation.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial implementation was incomplete or build/package incompatible enough that official evaluation still ended in compile_failed with all tests not run.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel followed the cleanroom prompt and focused on observable CLI behavior, especially missing std.cfg and static meta outputs.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial followed the same prompt but additionally tested the effect of providing cfg/std.cfg to unlock analysis behavior.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both recognized the task, but serial broadened observation into implementation-enabling behavior while parallel remained in broken-installation probe mode longer.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed the task into six probe areas and assigned each to a subagent, while parent ownership of implementation was deferred until report consolidation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no delegation or subagents and kept exploration, implementation, and packaging in the same actor's control flow.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel parallelized investigation but not implementation; serial used a single continuous workflow that reached implementation artifacts.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child context was scoped to probe reports, and the parent later consumed those reports as input to its own consolidation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial's context stayed local; it created cfg/std.cfg and used the resulting observations directly while implementing.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There was no missing child contract, but parallel introduced a report handoff phase that serial avoided.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel did not write a replacement implementation before cancellation and left only src as a directory with probe artifacts in the submission.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial copied static data and wrote src/cppcheck.py as an attempted Python reimplementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial reached concrete implementation; parallel did not progress beyond research and probing.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The swarm result returned all six reports, and the parent opened reports one by one before doing more probes.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial converted observations into local files and source without needing a child-result join.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a completed report lifecycle but no implementation lifecycle; serial advanced from findings to deliverable creation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel shared /workspace/probes for reports but had no source integration or final executable in the artifact.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial integrated captured data, cfg, source, and final executable into the submitted tree.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Shared writes in parallel did not collide, but they also did not assemble into a deliverable; serial assembled a fuller tree.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel verification was limited to original-binary probing and was interrupted before any implementation verification or acceptance decision.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also failed official evaluation, but it at least syntax-checked the generated source before cancellation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Neither reached acceptance; serial had some implementation-level check, while parallel never had an implementation to verify.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed the run with initial exploration, six reports, report reading, and additional probes, ending at parent cancellation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial was also cancelled by the run budget, but only after writing implementation source and packaging an executable.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The same time limit produced materially different closure artifacts because parallel deferred implementation behind the investigation phase.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official outcome is not discordant: both current completed evaluations failed with compile_failed and zero of 2550 tests run. The concrete task-solving difference is that parallel ended with no replacement executable after a probe-first swarm phase, while serial reached an attempted implementation and final executable before still failing.
parallel_contributors: Six delegated investigators produced reports, but implementation and assembly remained after report consumption and were not completed before cancellation.
The final parallel artifact listed probes and executable.orig but no required ./executable.
serial_contributors: Serial created cfg/std.cfg to observe richer original behavior, then copied captured data and wrote src/cppcheck.py.
Serial artifact contained ./executable even though official evaluation still failed.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial's attempted reimplementation was incomplete or packaging-incompatible enough to compile-fail; parallel had no implementation to compare for behavioral correctness.
evaluator_effects: Both evaluations stopped at compile_failed with all 2550 tests not_run, so official scoring does not distinguish later behavioral fidelity.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; the retained pattern explains a material process and artifact gap, not an official pass/fail divergence

candidates.reason: Rejected because the parent retained implementation ownership after the probe reports; the failure was that implementation was deferred until cancellation, not that no actor was assigned to implement.
Rejected because the children produced reports rather than separate component implementations, so there was no multi-component integration step left ownerless.
Rejected because no complete component set or entry-point implementation existed in parallel for a separate assembly owner to package.
Rejected because the parent owned the end-to-end flow by launching probes, reading reports, and continuing work; the defect is the serial investigation phase, not an unowned pipeline transition.
Rejected because no single mandatory preflight or oracle blocked all productive work; the parent created a broad probe-first phase with six investigators.

Retained because the parallel parent used AgentSwarm for six overlapping investigators, waited for and read the reports as a separate first phase, then continued probing until cancellation. Productive implementation and final assembly were deferred, leaving no replacement executable, while the serial run reached a source file and final executable before failing official evaluation.
candidates.realized_consequence: The parallel closure artifact contained probe reports and executable.orig but no required replacement ./executable, because implementation and assembly were still not reached at cancellation.
candidates.near_match_reason: Critical-Path Starvation is the nearest rejected label, but it would restate the downstream lack of implementation capacity; the direct boundary is that all investigation was completed as a first phase before implementation.

candidates.reason: Rejected as a near match because the lack of implementation capacity is the consequence of the probe-first investigation phase, not an independent auxiliary-work allocation episode.
Rejected because six probe agents all returned, and the evidence does not show excessive breadth or retries as the direct budget-exhaustion mechanism separate from serial investigation.
Rejected because no one child received an overbroad implementation assignment that failed; each delegated scope was a probe report and completed.
Rejected because the child briefs intentionally asked for behavioral probes and reports; no known implementation or delivery requirement was omitted from a child that was supposed to implement.
Rejected because no separately owned implementation components were delegated with missing interoperability contracts; the only returned artifacts were reports.
Rejected because the probe findings were returned through the swarm result and then read by the parent; there is no evidence that known information disappeared in transfer.
Rejected because the returned reports were large but the parent opened and consumed them before continuing; no dependent action is shown failing because the handoff was too bulky to reduce.
Rejected because no parent action relied on a child report describing a superseded workspace or requirement state.
Rejected because the reports did not present incompatible contracts or unresolved mutually exclusive implementation decisions.
Rejected because the parent never made a whole-task completion or acceptance decision; the trajectory ended by cancellation before final presentation.
Rejected because there was no replacement or retry actor repeating prior work without inherited findings.

candidates.reason: Rejected because the subagents completed and returned reports; the observed cancellation hit the parent run after report consumption, not an active child stopped early.
Rejected because no complete, directly promotable candidate or compatible component set existed in the parallel run; no final executable was ready but left unpromoted.
Rejected because no child implementation was merged after an integrated verification step; there was no merged implementation at all.
Rejected because no delegated implementation was completed or retrievable; the children produced probe reports, so there was no implementation to join.
Rejected because no verifier child produced a finding trapped below the parent; all probe reports returned through the swarm result.
Rejected because no required child failed, aborted, or was cancelled and left scope for takeover; all delegated probes completed.
Rejected because the parent read the completed reports after the swarm result, so the completed child outputs were not ignored.
Rejected because the parent was actively inspecting reports and running additional probes rather than passively waiting until timeout without inspection.
Rejected because concurrent writes were separate probe reports, not competing files claiming overlapping implementation or build ownership.
Rejected because there is no evidence that two live agents edited the same source or configuration file.
Rejected because no agent overwrote another agent's non-entry source or configuration work.
Rejected because renaming the original executable for observation was not a concurrent replacement of a deliverable owned or used by another agent, and no final deliverable was overwritten.
Rejected because no broad cleanup, rebuild, or promotion replaced another agent's final-tree outputs.
Rejected because the shared workspace writes were isolated probe report files and produced no concrete unstable-state or provenance problem.
Rejected because shared captured probe artifacts were intentionally used as reference material; no temporary or contaminated artifact was consumed as a stable implementation or environment input.

Productive implementation and final assembly were deferred, leaving no replacement executable, while the serial run reached a source file and final executable before failing official evaluation.
retained_patterns.realized_consequence: The parallel closure artifact contained probe reports and executable.orig but no required replacement ./executable, because implementation and assembly were still not reached at cancellation.

suppressed_same_chain_candidates: Critical-Path Starvation, Fan-out Budget Exhaustion, Blind Timeout Wait, Late Finalization, and Missing Implementation Join were considered but collapse into or fail under the same probe-first/cancellation chain.
cardinality_audit.underlabel_check: All 13 Level-2 rows and 32 Level-3 candidates were audited; only Serial Investigation has a directly evidenced parallel coordination boundary and realized consequence.
cardinality_audit.overlabel_check: No additional label was retained for downstream symptoms of the same episode, harmless shared report writes, ordinary implementation incompleteness, or absent events.
